name: David W. Patten
dateNote: He became an apostle on 15 February 1835 and died on 25 October 1838 after the Crooked River skirmish.
importance: Section 114 tells him in April 1838 to settle his business and prepare for a mission with the Twelve the next spring. He was mortally wounded at Crooked River before that mission began. Section 124 says the Lord has taken him and that another may be appointed to his calling.
connections: His brother John Patten baptized him in 1832, and he married Phoebe Ann Babcock. He served in the Twelve with Thomas B. Marsh and Brigham Young.

sources.title: David Wyman Patten, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP: born 14 Nov. 1799, Vermont; baptized 15 June 1832; apostle 15 Feb. 1835; moved to Far West 1836; died 25 Oct. 1838 after Crooked River. Section 112 does not name him in the text; he is listed there from the batch.
